runtime.description: The Rampart protects AvLee's forests with centaurs, dwarves, elves, pegasi, dendroids, unicorns, and dragons. Rangers and druids favor morale, resistance, and nature-bound battlefield control over donor Nature behavior.

allowedDebt: Rampart is mirrored in Homm3CustomFactionRegistry for selection/runtime identity, and source plugin unit import rows, bundles, static portraits, preview manifests, lab sidecars, and hero portraits are present for base/upgraded/alternate units. It remains asset-pending for town layers, build-tree icons, UI validation, and mechanics.

The manifest uses HoMM3/ToA named upgrade SIDs from docs/homm3_faction_plans/rampart.md, so release generators and runtime mirrors must use unitLines[].variantSids instead of assuming every custom variant is baseSid + suffix.

Do not promote Rampart through Core.zip until Dwarf resistance, Pegasus Magic Damper, Dendroid Binding lifecycle cleanup, Unicorn Blind/aura, dragon breath/immunity, Treasury, Mystic Pond, and Fountain of Fortune are represented or explicitly blocked in generated audit output.
